title: HB0746 (113th General Assembly): AN ACT to amend Tennessee Code Annotated, Title 39, Chapter 17, Part 13, relative to firearms.

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, Tennessee); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Tennessee text (Draft, 2023-01-31; crossfiled twin's official copy via the Internet Archive snapshot 20260514154504 of https://www.capitol.tn.gov/Bills/113/Bill/SB1037.pdf (it names HOUSE BILL 746; own link https://www.capitol.tn.gov/Bills/113/Bill/HB0746.pdf not archived))
provenance.note: Draft as filed (2023-01-31). The new subsection (a) limits owners to allowing only permit holders to carry concealed handguns (text printed 'carried in in'); deletions in Sections 2-7 remove the 'prohibition' wording and the offense per the state summary. The effect is partly taken from that summary.

operative_text:
SECTION 1 (TCA 39-17-1359(a)): (a) Except as provided in § 39-17-1313, an individual, corporation, business entity, or local, state, or federal government entity or agent thereof is authorized to restrict the possession of weapons by a person who is at a meeting conducted by, or on property owned, operated, or managed or under the control of the individual, corporation, business entity, or government entity by allowing a handgun to be carried in in a concealed manner only by persons authorized to carry a handgun pursuant to § 39-17-1351 or § 39-17-1366.
SECTION 4 (TCA 39-17-1359): Tennessee Code Annotated, Section 39-17-1359, is amended by deleting subdivisions (b)(3)(B) and (b)(4).
SECTION 6 (TCA 39-17-1359): Tennessee Code Annotated, Section 39-17-1359, is amended by deleting subsection (c).
